texts.label: text
texts.orig: The Company' restricted stock program is designed to provide incentives for management to achieve goals established by the Compensation Committee of the Company' Board of Directors (the Committee") . The awards act as retention device they vest over time allowing participants  to benefit   from dividends on shares as well potential stock appreciation Equity awards align management's interests with the long-term  interests shareholders The vesting periods of the Company' restricted stock plans vary as determined by the Committee. Restricted stock is granted to executive officers subject to both continued service and the satisfaction of certain annual performance goals and multi-year market conditions as determined by the Committee Restricted stock is granted to non-executive officers subject only to continued service The cost for market-based awards and awards that only require service is amortized on straight-line basis over the requisite service periods The total compensation expense for service and performance based awards is based upon the fair market value of the shares on the grant date
